text.body: mahopaniṣat yanmahopaniṣadvedyaṃ cidākāśatayā sthitam | paramādvaitasāmrājyaṃ tadrāmabrahma me gatiḥ || oṃ āpyāyantu māmāṅgāni vākprāṇaścakṣuḥ śrotramatho balamindriyāṇi ca || sarvāṇi sarvaṃ brahmopaniṣadaṃ māhaṃ brahma nirākuryāṃ mā mā brahma nirākarodanirakaraṇama stvanirākāraṇaṃ mestu tadātmani nirate ya upaniṣatsu dharmāste mayi santu te mayi santu|| oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || athāto mahopaniṣadaṃ vyākhyāsyamastadāhureko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīnna brahmā neśāno nāpo nāgnīṣomau neme dyāvāpṛthivī na nakṣatrāṇi na sūryo na candramāḥ | sa ekākī na ramate | tasya dhyānāntaḥsthasya yajñastomamucyate | tasminpuruṣāścaturdaśa jāyante | ekā kanyā | daśendriyāṇi mana ekādaśaṃ tejaḥ | dvādaśo'haṅkāraḥ | trayodaśakaḥ prāṇaḥ | caturdaśa ātmā | pañcadaśī buddhiḥ | bhūtāni pañca tanmātrāṇi | pañca mahābhūtāni | sa ekaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ puruṣaḥ | tatpuruṣaṃ puruṣo niveśya nāsya pradhānasaṃvatsarā jāyante | saṃvatsarādadhijāyante | atha punareva nārāyaṇaḥ so'nyatkāmo manasādhyāyata | tasya dhyānāntaḥsthasya lalāṭāttryakṣaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ puruṣo jāyate | bibhracchriyaṃ yaśaḥ satyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapo vairāgyaṃ mana aiśvaryaṃ sapraṇavā vyāhṛtaya ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṅgirasaḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi tānyaṅge samāśritāni | tasmādīśāno mahādevo mahādevaḥ | atha punareva nārāyaṇaḥ so'nyatkāmo manasādhyāyata | tasya dhyānāntaḥsthasya lalāṭātsvedo'papat | tā imāḥ pratatā āpaḥ | tatastejo hiraṇmayamanḍalam | tatra brahmā caturmukho'jāyata | so'dhyāyt | pūrvābhimukho bhūtvā bhūriti vyāhṛtirgāyatraṃ chanda ṛgvedo'gnirdevatā | paścimābhimukho bhūtvā bhuvariti vyāhṛtistraiṣṭubhaṃ chando yajurvedo vāyurdevatā | uttarābhimukho bhūtvā svariti vyāhṛtirjāgrataṃ chandaḥ sāmavedaḥ sūryo devatā | dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā maharitivyāhṛtirānuṣṭabha chando'tharvavedāḥ somo devatā | sahasraśīrṣaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ viśvasambhuvam | viśvataḥ paramaṃ nityaṃ viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim | viśvamevedaṃ puruṣastadviśvamupajīvati | patiṃ viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ samudre viśvarūpiṇam | padmakośapratīkāśaṃ lambatyākośasaṃnibham | hṛdayaṃ cāpyadhomukhaṃ santatyai sītkarābhīśca | tasya madhye mahānarcirviśvarcirviśvatomukham | tasya madhye vahniśikhā aṇīyordhvā vyavasthitā | tasyāḥ śikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitā | sa brahmā sa īśānaḥ sendraḥ so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāḍiti mahopaniṣat || iti prathamodhyāyaḥ || 1.1|| śuko nāma mahātejāḥ svarūpānandatatparaḥ | jātamātreṇa munirāḍ yatsatyaṃ tadavāptavān || 2.1|| tenāsau svavivekena svayameva mahāmanāḥ | pravicārya ciraṃ sādhu svātmaniścayamāptavān || 2|| anākhyatvādagamyatvānmanaḥṣaṣṭhendriyasthiteḥ | cinmātramevamātmāṇurākāśādapi sūkṣmakaḥ || 3|| cidaṇoḥ paramasyāntaḥ koṭibrahmāṇḍareṇavaḥ | utpattisthitimabhyetya līyante śaktiparyayāt || 4|| ākāśaṃ bāhyaśūnyatvādanākāśaṃ tu cittvataḥ | na kiṃcidyadanirdeśyaṃ vastu satteti kiṃcana || 5|| cetano'sau prakāśatvādvedyābhāvācchilopamaḥ | svātmani vyomani svasthe jagadunmeṣacitrakṛt || 6|| tadbhāmātramidaṃ viśvamiti na syāttataḥ pṛthak | jagadbhedo'pi tadbhānamiti bhedo'pi tanmayaḥ || 7|| sarvagaḥ sarvasambandho gatyabhāvānna gacchati | nāstyasāvaśrayābhāvātsadrūpatvādathāsti ca || 8|| vijñānamānandaṃ brahma rāterdātuḥ parāyaṇam | sarvasaṃkalpasaṃnyāsaścetasā yatparigrahaḥ || 9|| jāgrataḥ pratyayābhāvaṃ yasyāhuḥ pratyayaṃ budhāḥ | yatsaṃkocavikāsābhyāṃ jagatpralayasṛṣṭayaḥ || 2.10|| niṣṭhā vedāntavākyānāmatha vācāmagocaraḥ | ahaṃ saccitparānandabrahmaivāsmi na cetaraḥ || 11|| svayaiva sūkṣmayā buddhyā sarvaṃ vijñātavāñchukaḥ | svayaṃ prāpte pare vastunyaviśrāntamanāḥ sthitaḥ || 12|| idaṃ vastviti viśvāsaṃ nāsāvātmanyupāyayau | kevalaṃ virarāmāsya ceto viṣayacāpalam | bhogebhyo bhūribhaṅgebhyo dhārābhya iva cātakaḥ || 13|| kadā so'malaprajño merāvekāntasaṃsthitaḥ | papraccha pitaraṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim || 14|| saṃsārāḍambaramidaṃ kathamabhyutthitaṃ mune | kathaṃ ca praśamaṃ yāti kiṃ yatkasya kadā vada || 15|| evaṃ pṛṣṭena muninā vyāsenākhilamātmaje | yathāvadakhilaṃ proktaṃ vaktavyaṃ viditātmanā || 16|| ajñāsiṣaṃ pūrvamevamahamityatha tatpituḥ | sa śukaḥ svakayā buddhyā na vākyaṃ bahu manyate || 17|| vyāso'pi bhagavānbuddhvā putrābhiprāyamīdṛśam | pratyuvāca punaḥ putraṃ nāhaṃ jānāmi tattvataḥ || 18|| janako nāma bhūpālo vidyate mithilāpure | yathāvadvettyasau vedyaṃ tasmātsarvamavāpsyasi || 19|| pitretyuktaḥ śukaḥ prāyātsumerorvasudhātalam | videhanagarīṃ prāpa janakenābhipālitām || 2.20|| āvedito'sau yāṣṭīkairjanakāya mahātmane | dvāri vyāsasuto rājañchuko'tra sthitavāniti || 21|| jijñāsārthaṃ śukasyāsāvāstāmevetyavajñayā | uktvā babhūva janakastūṣṇīṃ sapta dinānyatha || 22|| tataḥ praveśayāmāsa janakaḥ śukamaṅgaṇe | tatrāhāni sa saptaiva tathaivāvasadunmanāḥ || 23|| tataḥ praveśayāmāsa janako'ntaḥpurājire | rājā na dṛśyate tāvaditi saptadināni tam || 24|| tatronmadābhiḥ kāntābhirbhojanairbhogasaṃcayaiḥ | janako lālayāmāsa śukaṃ śaśinibhānanam || 25|| te bhogāstāni bhojyāni vyāsaputrasya tanmanaḥ | nājahvurmandapavano baddhapīṭhamivācalam || 26|| kevalaṃ susamaḥ svaccho maunī muditamānasaḥ | saṃpūrṇa iva śītāṃśuratiṣṭhadamalaḥ śukaḥ || 27|| parijñātasvabhāvaṃ taṃ śukaṃ sa janako nṛpaḥ | ānīya muditātmānamavalokya nanāma ha || 28|| niḥśeṣitajagatkāryaḥ prāptākhilamanorathaḥ | kimīpsitaṃ tavetyāha kṛtasvāgata āha tam || 29|| saṃsārāḍambaramidaṃ kathamabhyutthitaṃ guro | kathaṃ praśamamāyāti yathāvatkathayāśu me ||2.30|| yathāvadakhilaṃ proktaṃ janakena mahātmanā | tadeva tatpurā proktaṃ tasya pitrā mahādhiyā || 31|| svayameva mayā pūrvamabhijñātaṃ viśeṣataḥ | etadeva hi pṛṣṭena pitrā me samudāhṛtam || 32|| bhavatāpyeṣa evārthaḥ kathito vāgvidāṃ vara | eṣa eva hi vākyārthaḥ śāstreṣu paridṛśyate || 33|| manovikalpasaṃjātaṃ tadvikalpaparikṣayāt | kṣīyate dagdhasaṃsāro niḥsāra iti niścitaḥ || 34|| tatkimetanmahābhāga satyaṃ brūhi mamācalam | tvatto viśramamāpnomi cetasā bhramatā jagat || 35|| śruṇu tāvadidānīṃ tvaṃ kathyamānamidaṃ mayā | śrīśukaṃ jñānavistāraṃ buddhisārāntarāntaram || 36|| yadvijñānātpumānsadyo jīvanmuktatvamāpnuyāt || 37|| dṛśyaṃ nāstīti bodhena manaso dṛśyamārjanam | saṃpannaṃ cettadutpannā parā nirvāṇanirvṛtiḥ || 38|| aśeṣeṇa parityāgo vāsanāyāṃ ya uttamaḥ | mokṣa ityucyate sadbhiḥ sa eva vimalakramaḥ || 39|| ye śuddhavāsanā bhūyo na janmānarthabhāginaḥ | jñātajñeyāsta ucyante jīvanmuktā mahādhiyaḥ || 2.40|| padārthabhāvanādārḍhyaṃ bandha ityabhidhīyate | vāsanātānavaṃ brahmanmokṣa ityabhidhīyate || 41|| tapaḥ prabhṛtinā yasmai hetunaiva vinā punaḥ | bhogā iha na rocante sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 42|| āpatatsu yathākālaṃ sukhaduḥkheṣvanārataḥ | na hṛṣyati glāyati yaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 43|| harṣāmarṣabhayakrodhakāmakārpaṇyadṛṣṭibhiḥ | na parāmṛśyate yo'ntaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 44|| ahaṃkāramayīṃ tyaktvā vāsanāṃ līlayaiva yaḥ | tiṣṭhati dhyeyasaṃtyāgī sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 45|| īpsitānīpsite na sto yasyāntarvartidṛṣṭiṣu | suṣuptivadyaścarati sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 46|| adhyātmaratirāsīnaḥ pūrṇaḥ pāvanamānasaḥ | prāptānuttamaviśrāntirna kiṃcidiha vāñchati | yo jīvati gatasnehaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 47|| saṃvedyena hṛdākāśe manāgapi na lipyate | yasyāsāvajaḍā saṃvitsa jīvanmukta ucyate || 48|| rāgadveṣau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dharmādharmau phalāphale | yaḥ karotyanapekṣyaiva sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 49|| maunavānnirahaṃbhāvo nirmāno muktamatsaraḥ | yaḥ karoti gatodvegaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 2.50|| sarvatra vigatasneho yaḥ sākṣivadavasthitaḥ | niriccho vartate kārye sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 51|| yena dharmamadharmaṃ ca manomananamīhitam | sarvamantaḥ parityaktaṃ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 52|| yāvatī dṛśyakalanā sakaleyaṃ vilokyate | sā yena suṣṭhu saṃtyaktā sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 53|| kaṭvamlalavaṇaṃ tiktamamṛṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭameva ca | samameva ca yo bhuṅkte sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 54|| jarāmaraṇamāpacca rājyaṃ dāridryameva ca | ramyamityeva yo bhuṅkte sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 55|| dharmādharmau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā maraṇajanmanī | dhiyā yena susaṃtyaktaṃ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 56|| udvegānandarahitaḥ samayā svacchayā dhiyā | na śocate na codeti sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 57|| sarvecchāḥ sakalāḥ śaṅkāḥ sarvehāḥ sarvaniścayāḥ | dhiyā yena parityaktāḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 58|| janmasthitivināśeṣu sodayāstamayeṣu ca | samameva mano yasya sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 59|| na kiṃcana dveṣṭi tathā na kiṃcidapi kāṅkṣati | bhuṅkte yaḥ prakṛtānbhogānsa jīvanmukta ucyate || 2.60|| śāntasaṃsārakalanaḥ kalāvānapi niṣkalaḥ | yaḥ sacitto'pi niścittaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 61|| yaḥ samastārthajāleṣu vyavahāryapi niḥspṛhaḥ | parārtheṣviva pūrṇātmā sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 62|| jīvanmuktapadaṃ tyaktvā svadehe kālasātkṛte | viśatyadehamuktatvaṃ pavano'spandatāmiva || 63|| videhamukto nodeti nāstameti na śāmyati | na sannāsanna dūrastho na cāhaṃ na ca netaraḥ || 64|| tataḥ stimitagaṃbhīraṃ na tejo na tamastatam | anākhyamanabhivyaktaṃ satkiṃcidavaśiṣyate || 65|| na śūnyaṃ nāpi cākāro na dṛśyaṃ nāpi darśanam | na ca bhūtapadārthaughasadanantatayā sthitam || 66|| kimapyavyapadeśātmā pūrṇātpūrṇatarākṛtiḥ | na sannāsanna sadasanna bhāvo bhāvanaṃ na ca || 67|| cinmātraṃ caityarahitamanantamajaraṃ śivam | anādimadhyaparyantaṃ yadanādi nirāmayam || 68|| draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyānāṃ madhye yaddarśanaṃ smṛtam | nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcinniścayo'styaparo mune || 69|| svayameva tvayā jñātaṃ gurutaśca punaḥ śrutam | svasaṃkalpavaśādbaddho niḥsaṃkalpādvimucyate || 2.70|| tena svayaṃ tvayā jñātaṃ jñeyaṃ yasya mahātmanaḥ | bhogebhyo hyaratirjātā dṛśyādvā sakalādiha || 71|| prāptaṃ prāptavyamakhilaṃ bhavatā pūrṇacetasā | svarūpe tapasi brahmanmuktastvaṃ bhrāntimutsṛja || 72|| atibāhyaṃ tathā bāhyamantarābhyantaraṃ dhiyaḥ | śuka paśyanna paśyestvaṃ sākṣī saṃpūrṇakevalaḥ || 73|| viśaśrāma śukastūṣṇīṃ svasthe paramavastuni | vītaśokabhayāyāso nirīhaśchinnasaṃśayaḥ || 74|| jagāma śikharaṃ meroḥ samādhyarthamakhaṇḍitam || 75|| tatra varṣasahasrāṇi nirvikalpasamādhinā | deśe sthitvā śaśāmāsāvātmanyasnehadīpavat || 76|| vyapagatakalanākalaṅkaśuddhaḥ svayamamalātmani pāvane pade'sau | salilakaṇa ivāṃbudhau mahātmā vigalitavāsanamekatāṃ jagāma || 2.77|| iti mahopaniṣat | iti dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2|| nidāgho nāma munirāṭ prāptavidyaśca bālakaḥ | vihṛtastīrthayātrārthaṃ pitrānujñātavānsvayam || 3.1|| sārdhatrikoṭitīrtheṣu snātvā gṛhamupāgataḥ | svodantaṃ kathayāmāsa ṛbhuṃ natvā mahāyaśāḥ || 2|| sārdhatrikoṭitīrtheṣu snānapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ | prādurbhūtomanasi me vicāraḥ so'yamīdṛśaḥ || 3|| jāyate mriyate loko mriyate jananāya ca | asthiraḥ sarva eveme sacarācaraceṣṭitāḥ | sarvāpadāṃ padaṃ pāpā bhāvā vibhavabhūmayaḥ || 4|| ayaḥśalākāsadṛśāḥ parasparamasaṅginaḥ | śuṣyante kevalā bhāvā manaḥkalpanayānayā || 5|| bhāveṣvaratirāyātā pathikasya maruṣviva | śāmyatīdaṃ kathaṃ duḥkhamiti tapto'smi cetasā || 6|| cintānicayacakrāṇi nānandāya dhanāni me | saṃprasūtakalatrāṇi gṛhāṇyugrāpadāmiva || 7|| iyamasmi sthitodārā saṃsāre paripelavā | śrīrmune parimohāya sāpi nūnaṃ na śarmadā || 8|| āyuḥ pallavakoṇāgralambāmbukaṇabhaṅguram | unmatta iva saṃtyajya yāmyakāṇḍe śarīrakam || 9|| viṣayāśī viṣāsaṅgaparijarjaracetasām | aprauḍhātmavivekānāmāyurāyāsakāraṇam || 3.10|| yujyate veṣṭanaṃ vāyorākāśasya ca khaṇḍanam | granthanaṃ ca taraṅgāṇāmāsthā nāyuṣi yujyate || 11|| prāpyaṃ saṃprāpyate yena bhūyo yena na śocyate | parāyā nirvṛteḥ sthānaṃ yattajjīvitamucyate || 12|| taravo'pi hi jīvanti jīvanti mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | sa jīvati mano yasya mananenopajīvati || 13|| jātāsta eva jagati jantavaḥ sādhujīvitāḥ | ye punarneha jāyante śeṣā jaraṭhagardabhāḥ || 14|| bhāro vivekinaḥ śāstraṃ bhāro jñānaṃ ca rāgiṇaḥ | aśāntasya mano bhāro bhāro'nātmavido vapuḥ || 15|| ahaṃkāravaśādāpadahaṃkārāddurādhayaḥ | ahaṃkāravaśādīhā nāhaṃkārātparo ripuḥ || 16|| ahaṃkāravaśādyadyanmayā bhuktaṃ carācaram | tattatsarvamavastveva vastvahaṃkārariktatā || 17|| itaścetaśca suvyagraṃ vyarthamevābhidhāvati | mano dūrataraṃ yāti grāme kauleyako yathā || 18|| krūreṇa jaḍatāṃ yātā tṛṣṇābhāryānugāminā | vaśaḥ kauleyakeneva brahmanmukto'smi cetasā || 19|| apyabdhipānānmahataḥ sumerūnmūlanādapi | api vahnyaśanādbrahmanviṣamaścittanigrahaḥ || 3.20|| cittaṃ kāraṇamarthānāṃ tasminsati jagattrayam | tasminkṣīṇe jagatkṣīṇaṃ taccikitsyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 21|| yāṃ yāmahaṃ muniśreṣṭha saṃśrayāmi guṇaśriyam | tāṃ tāṃ kṛntati me tṛṣṇā tantrīmiva kumūṣikā || 22|| padaṃ karotyalaṅghye'pi tṛptā viphalamīhate | ciraṃ tiṣṭhati naikatra tṛṣṇā capalamarkaṭī || 23|| kṣaṇamāyāti pātālaṃ kṣaṇaṃ yāti nabhasthalam | kṣaṇaṃ bhramati dikkuñje tṛṣṇā hṛtpadmaṣaṭpadī || 24|| sarvasaṃsāraduḥkhānāṃ tṛṣṇaikā dīrghaduḥkhadā | antaḥpurasthamapi yā yojayatyatisaṃkaṭe || 25|| tṛṣṇāviṣūcikāmantraścintātyāgo hi sa dvija | stokenānandamāyāti stokenāyāti khedatām || 26|| nāsti dehasamaḥ śocyo nīco guṇavivarjitaḥ || 27|| kalevaramahaṃkāragṛhasthasya mahāgṛham | luṭhatvabhyetu vā sthairyaṃ kimanena guro mama || 28|| paṅktibaddhendriyapaśuṃ valgattṛṣṇāgṛhāṅgaṇam | cittabhṛtyajanākīrṇaṃ neṣṭaṃ dehagṛhaṃ mama || 29|| jihvāmarkaṭikākrāntavadanadvārabhīṣaṇam | dṛṣṭadantāsthiśakalaṃ neṣṭaṃ dehagṛhaṃ mama || 3.30|| raktamāṃsamayasyāsya sabāhyābhyantare mune | nāśaikadharmiṇo brūhi kaiva kāyasya ramyatā || 31|| taḍitsu śaradabhreṣu gandharvanagareṣu ca | sthairyaṃ yena vinirṇītaṃ sa viśvasitu vigrahe || 32|| śaiśave guruto bhītirmātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā | janato jyeṣṭhabālācca śaiśavaṃ bhayamandiram || 33|| svacittabilasaṃsthena nānāvibhramakāriṇā | balātkāmapiśācena vivaśaḥ paribhūyate || 34|| dāsāḥ putrāḥ striyaścaiva bāndhavāḥ suhṛdastathā | hasantyunmattakamiva naraṃ vārdhakakampitam || 35|| dainyadoṣamayī dīrghā vardhate vārdhake spṛhā | sarvāpadāmekasakhī hṛdi dāhapradāyinī || 36|| kvacidvā vidyate yaiṣā saṃsāre sukhabhāvanā | āyuḥ stambamivāsādya kālastāmapi kṛntati || 37|| tṛṇaṃ pāṃsuṃ mahendraṃ ca suvarṇaṃ merusarṣapam | ātmaṃbharitayā sarvamātmasātkartumudyataḥ | kālo'yaṃ sarvasaṃhārī tenākrāntaṃ jagattrayam || 38|| māṃsapāñcālikāyāstu yantraloleaṅgapañjare | snāyvasthigranthiśālinyāḥ striyaḥ kimiva śobhanam || 39|| tvaṅmāṃsaraktabāṣpāmbu pṛthakkṛtvā vilocane | samālokaya ramyaṃ cetkiṃ mudhā parimuhyasi || 3.40|| meruśṛṅgataṭollāsigaṅgācalarayopamā | dṛṣṭā yasminmune muktāhārasyollāsaśālitā || 41|| śmaśāneṣu diganteṣu sa eva lalanāstanaḥ | śvabhirāsvādyate kāle laghupiṇḍa ivāndhasaḥ || 42|| keśakajjaladhāriṇyo duḥsparśā locanapriyāḥ | duṣkṛtāgniśikhā nāryo dahanti tṛṇavannaram || 43|| jvalatāmatidūre'pi sarasā api nīrasāḥ | striyo hi narakāgnīnāmindhanaṃ cāru dāruṇam || 44|| kāmanāmnā kirātena vikīrṇā mugdhacetasaḥ | nāryo naravihaṅgānāmaṅgabandhanavāgurāḥ || 45|| janmapalvalamatsyānāṃ cittakardamacāriṇām | puṃsāṃ durvāsanārajjurnārī baḍiśapiṇḍikā || 46|| sarveṣāṃ doṣaratnānāṃ susamudgikayānayā | duḥkhaśṛṅkhalayā nityamalamastu mama striyā || 47|| yasya strī tasya bhogecchā niḥstrīkasya kva bhogabhūḥ | striyaṃ tyaktvā jagattyaktaṃ jagattyaktvā sukhī bhavet || 48|| diśo'pi na hi dṛśyante deśo'pyanyopadeśakṛt | śailā api viśīryante śīryante tārakā api || 49|| śuṣyantyapi samudrāśca dhruvo'pyadhruvajīvanaḥ | siddhā api vinaśyanti jīryante dānavādayaḥ || 3.50|| parameṣṭhyapi niṣṭhāvānhīyate harirapyajaḥ | bhāvo'pyabhāvamāyāti jīryante vai digīśvarāḥ || 51|| brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sarvā vā bhūtajātayaḥ | nāśamevānudhāvanti salilānīva vāḍavam || 52|| āpadaḥ kṣaṇamāyānti kṣaṇamāyānti saṃpadaḥ | kṣaṇaṃ janmātha maraṇaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva tat || 53|| aśūreṇa hatāḥ śūrā ekenāpi śataṃ hatam | viṣaṃ viṣayavaiṣamyaṃ na viṣaṃ viṣamucyate || 54|| janmāntaraghnā viṣayā ekajanmaharaṃ viṣam | iti me doṣadāvāgnidagdhe saṃprati cetasi || 55|| sphuranti hi na bhogāśā mṛgatṛṣṇāsaraḥsvapi | ato māṃ bodhayāśu tvaṃ tattvajñānena vai guro || 56|| no cenmaunaṃ samāsthāya nirmāno gatamatsaraḥ | bhāvayanmanasā viṣṇuṃ lipikarmārpitopamaḥ || 3.57|| iti mahopaniṣat | iti tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3|| nidāgha tava nāstanyajjñeyaṃ jñānavatāṃ vara | prajñayā tvaṃ vijānāsi īśvarānugṛhītayā | cittamālinyasaṃjātaṃ mārjayāmi bhramaṃ mune || 4.1|| mokṣadvāre dvārapālaścatvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ | śamo vicāraḥ santoṣaścaturthaḥ sādhusaṅgamaḥ || 2|| ekaṃ vā sarvayatnena sarvamutsṛjya saṃśrayet | ekasminvaśage yānti catvāro'pi vaśaṃ gatāḥ || 3|| śāstraiḥ sajjanasaṃparkapūrvakaiśca tapodamaiḥ | ādau saṃsāramuktyarthaṃ prajñāmevābhivardhayet || 4|| svānubhūteśca śāstrasya guroścevaikavākyatā | yasyābhyāsena tenātma satataṃ cāvalokyate || 5|| saṃkalpāśānusandhānavarjanaṃ cetpratikṣaṇam | karoṣi tadacittatvaṃ prāpta evāsi pāvanam || 6|| cetaso yadakartṛtvaṃ tatsamādhānamīritam | tadeva kevalībhāvaṃ sāśubhā nirvṛtiḥ parā || 7|| cetasā saṃparityajya sarvabhāvātmabhāvanām | yathā tiṣṭhasi tiṣṭha tvaṃ mūkāndhabadhiropamaḥ || 8|| sarvaṃ praśāntamajamekamanādimadhya mābhāsvaraṃ svadanamātramacaityacihnam | sarvaṃ praśāntamiti śabdamayī ca dṛṣṭi rbādhārthameva hi mudhaiva tadomitīdam || 4.10|| nityaprabuddhacittastvaṃ kurvanvāpi jagatkriyām | ātmaikatvaṃ viditvā tvaṃ tiṣṭhākṣubdhamahābdhivat || 11|| tattvāvabodha evāsau vāsanātṛṇapāvakaḥ | proktaḥ samādhiśabdena natu tūṣṇīmavasthitiḥ || 12|| niricche saṃsthite ratne yathā lokaḥ pravartate | sattāmātre pare tattve tathaivāyaṃ jagadgaṇaḥ || 13|| ataścātmani kartṛtvamakartṛtvaṃ ca vai mune | niricchatvādakartāsau kartā saṃnidhimātrataḥ || 14|| te dve brahmaṇi vindeti kartṛtākartṛte mune | yatraivaiṣa camatkārastamāśritya sthiro bhava || 15|| tasmānnityamakartāhamiti bhāvanayeddhayā | paramāmṛtanāmnī sā samataivāvaśiṣyate || 16|| nidāgha śṛṇu sattvasthā jātā bhuvi mahāguṇāḥ | te nityamevābhyuditā muditāḥ sva ivendavaḥ || 17|| nāpadi glānimāyānti niśi hemāmbujaṃ yathā | nehante prakṛtādanyadramante śiṣṭavartmani || 18|| ākṛtyaiva virājante maitryādiguṇavṛttibhiḥ | samāḥ samarasāḥ saumya satataṃ sādhuvṛttayaḥ || 19|| abdhivaddhatamaryāda bhavati viśadāśayāḥ | niyatiṃ na vimuñcanti mahānto bhāskarā iva || 4.20|| ko'haṃ kathamidaṃ ceti saṃsāramalamātatam | pravicāryaṃ prayatnena prājñena sahasādhunā || 21|| nākarmasu niyoktavyaṃ nānāryeṇa sahāvaset | draṣṭavyaḥ sarvasaṃhartā na mṛtyuravahelayā || 22|| śarīramasthimāṃsaṃ ca tyaktvā raktādyaśobhanam | bhūtamuktāvalītantuṃ cinmātramavalokayet || 23|| upādeyānupatanaṃ heyaikāntavisarjanam | yadetanmanaso rūpaṃ tadbāhyaṃ viddhi netarat || 24|| guruśāstroktamārgeṇa svānubhūtyā ca cidghane | brahmaivāhamiti jñātvā vītaśoko bhavenmuniḥ || 25|| yatra niśitāsiśatapātanamutpalatāḍanavatsoḍhavyamagninā dāho himasecanamivāṅgāravartanaṃ candanacarceva niravadhinārācavikirapāto nidāghavinodanadhārā gṛhaśīkaravarṣaṇamiva svaśiracchedaḥ sukhanidreva mūkīkaraṇamānanamudreva bādhiryaṃ mahānupacaya ivedaṃ nāvahelanayā bhavitavyamevaṃ dṛḍhavairāgyādbodho bhavati || guruvākyasamudbhūtasvānubhūtyādiśuddhayā | yasyābhyāsena tenātmā satataṃ cāvalokyate || 26|| vinaṣṭadigbhramasyāpi yathāpūrvaṃ vibhāti dik | tathā vijñānavidhvastaṃ jagannāstīti bhāvaya || 27|| na dhanānypakurvanti na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ | na kāyakleśavaidhuryaṃ na tīrthāyatanāśrayaḥ | kevalaṃ tanmanomātramayenāsādyate padam || 28|| yāni duḥkhāni yā tṛṣṇā duḥsahā ye durādhayaḥ | śāntacetaḥsu tatsarvaṃ tamo'rkeṣviva naśyati || 29|| mātarīva paraṃ yānti viṣamāṇi mṛdūni ca | viśvāsamiha bhūtāni sarvāṇi śamaśālini || 4.30|| na rasāyanapānena na lakṣmyāliṅgitena ca | na tathā sukhamāpnoti śamenāntaryathā janaḥ || 31|| śrutvā spṛṣṭvā ca bhuktvā ca dṛṣṭvā jñātvā śubhāśubham | na hṛṣyati glāyati yaḥ sa śānta iti kathyate || 32|| tuṣārakarabiṃbācchaṃ mano yasya nirākulam | maraṇotsavayuddheṣu sa śānta iti kathyate || 33|| tapasviṣu bahujñeṣu yājakeṣu nṛpeṣu ca | balavatsu guṇāḍhyeṣu śamavāneva rājate || 34|| santoṣāmṛtapānena ye śāntāstṛptimāgatāḥ | ātmārāmā mahātmānaste mahāpadamāgatāḥ || 35|| aprāptaṃ hi parityajya saṃprāpte samatāṃ gataḥ | adṛṣṭakhedākhedo yaḥ santuṣṭa iti kathyate || 36|| nābhinandatyasaṃprāptaṃ prāptaṃ bhuṅkte yathepsitam | yaḥ sa saumyasamācāraḥ santuṣṭa iti kathyate || 37|| ramate dhīryatāprāpte sādhvīvā'ntaḥpurājire | sā jīvanmuktatodeti svarūpānandadāyinī || 38|| yathākṣaṇaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yathādeśaṃ yathāsukham | yathāsaṃbhavasatsaṅgamimaṃ mokṣapathakramam | tāvadvicārayetprājño yāvadviśrāntimātmani || 39|| turyaviśrāntiyuktasya nivṛttasya bhavārṇavāt | jīvato'jīvataścaiva gṛhasthasyāthavā yateḥ || 4.40|| nākṛtena kṛtenārtho na śrutismṛtivibhramaiḥ | nirmandara ivāmbodhiḥ sa tiṣṭhati yathāsthitaḥ || 41|| sarvātmavedanaṃ śuddhaṃ yadodeti tavātmakam | bhāti prasṛtidikkālabāhyaṃ cidrūpadehakam || 42|| evamātmā yathā yatra samullāsamupāgataḥ | tiṣṭhatyāśu tathā tatra tadrūpaśca virājate || 43|| yadidaṃ dṛśyate sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | tatsuṣuptāviva svapnaḥ kalpānte pravinaśyati || 44|| ṛtamātmā paraṃbrahma satyamityādikā budhaiḥ | kalpitā vyavahārārthaṃ yasya saṃjñā mahātmanaḥ || 45|| yathā kaṭakaśabdārthaḥ pṛthagbhāvo na kāñcanāt | na hemakaṭakāttadvajjagacchabdārthatā parā || 46|| teneyamindrajālaśrīrjagati pravitanyate | draṣṭudṛśyasya sattāntarbandha ityabhidhīyate || 47|| draṣṭā dṛśyavaśādbaddho dṛśyābhāve vimucyate | jagattvamahamityādisargātmā dṛśyamucyate || 48|| manasaivendrajālaśrīrjagati pravitanyate | yāvadetatsaṃbhavati tāvanmokṣo na vidyate || 49|| brahmaṇā tanyate viśvaṃ manasaiva svayaṃbhuvā | manomayamato viśvaṃ yannāma paridṛśyate || 4.50|| na bāhye nāpi hṛdaye sadrūpaṃ vidyate manaḥ | yadarthaṃ pratibhānaṃ tanmana ityabhidhīyate || 51|| saṃkalpanaṃ mano viddhi saṃkalpastanna vidyate | yatra saṃkalpanaṃ tatra mano'stītyavagamyatām || 52|| saṃkalpamanasī bhinne na kadācana kenacit | saṃkalpajāte galite svarūpamavaśiṣyate || 53|| ahaṃ tvaṃ jagatityādau praśānte dṛśyasaṃbhrame | syāttādṛśī kevalatā dṛśye sattāmupāgate || 54|| mahāpralayasaṃpattau hyasattāṃ samupāgate | aśeṣadṛśye sargādau śāntamevāvaśiṣyate || 55|| astyanastamito bhāsvānajo devo nirāmayaḥ | sarvadā sarvakṛtsarvaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ || 56|| yato vāco nivartante yo muktairavagamyate | yasya cātmādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ kalpitā na svabhāvataḥ || 57|| cittākāśaṃ cidākāśamākāśaṃ ca tṛtīyakam | dvābhyāṃ śūnyataraṃ viddhi cidākāśaṃ mahāmune || 58|| deśāddeśāntaraprāptau saṃvido madhyameva yat | nimeṣeṇa cidākāśaṃ tadviddhi munipuṅgava || 59|| tasminnirastaniḥśeṣasaṃkalpasthitimeṣi cet | sarvātmakaṃ padaṃ śāntaṃ tadā prāpnoṣyasaṃśayaḥ || 4.60|| uditaudāryasaundaryavairāgyarasagarbhiṇī | ānandasyandinī yaiṣā samādhirabhidhīyate || 61|| dṛśyāsaṃbhavabodhena rāgadveṣāditānave | ratirbaloditā yāsau samādhirabhidhīyate || 62|| dṛśyāsaṃbhavabodho hi jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ cidātmakam | tadeva kevalībhāvaṃ tato'nyatsakalaṃ mṛṣā || 63|| matta airāvato baddhaḥ sarṣapīkoṇakoṭare | maśakena kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ siṃhaughaireṇukoṭare || 64|| padmākṣe sthāpito merurnigīrṇo bhṛṅgasūnunā | nidāgha viddhi tādṛktvaṃ jagatetadbhramātmakam || 65|| cittameva hi saṃsāro rogādikleśadūṣitam | tadeva tairvinirmuktaṃ bhavānta iti kathyate || 66|| manasā bhāvyamāno hi dehatāṃ yāti dehakaḥ | dehavāsanayā mukto dehadharmairna lipyate || 67|| kalpaṃ kṣaṇīkarotyantaḥ kṣaṇaṃ nayati kalpatām | manovilāsasaṃsāra iti me niścitā matiḥ || 68|| nāvirato duścaritānnāśānto nāsamāhitaḥ | nāśāntamanaso vāpi prajñānenainamāpnuyāt || 69|| tadbrahmānandamadvandvaṃ nirguṇaṃ satyacidghanam | viditvā svātmano rūpaṃ na bibheti kadācana || 4.70|| parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāntaṃ svarūpatejomayaśāśvataṃ śivam | kaviṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ sanātanaṃ sarveśvaraṃ sarvadevairupāsyam || 71|| ahaṃ brahmeti niyataṃ mokṣaheturmahātmanām | dve pade bandhamokṣāya nirmameti mameti ca | mameti badhyate janturnirmameti vimucyate || 72|| jīveśvarādirūpeṇa cetanācetanātmakam | īkṣaṇādipraveśāntā sṛṣṭirīśena kalpitā | jāgradādivimokṣāntaḥ saṃsāro jīvakalpitaḥ || 73|| triṇācikādiyogāntā īśvarabhrāntimāśritāḥ | lokāyatādisāṃkhyāntā jīvavibhrāntimāśritāḥ || 74|| tasmānmumukṣibhirnaiva matirjīveśavādayoḥ | kāryā kiṃtu brahmatattvaṃ niścalena vicāryatām || 75|| aviśeṣeṇa sarvaṃ tu yaḥ paśyati cidanvayāt | sa eva sākṣādvijñānī sa śivaḥ sa harirvidhiḥ || 76|| durlabho viṣayatyāgo durlabhaṃ tattvadarśanam | durlabhā sahajāvasthā sadguroḥ karuṇāṃ vinā || 77|| utpannaśaktirbodhasya tyaktaniḥśeṣakarmaṇaḥ | yoginaḥ sahajāvasthā svayamevopajāyate || 78|| yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnalpamapyantaraṃ naraḥ | vijānāti tadā tasya bhayaṃ syānnatra saṃśayaḥ || 79|| sarvagaṃ saccidānandaṃ jñānacakṣurnirīkṣate | ajñānacakṣurnekṣeta bhāsvantaṃ bhānumandahvat || 4.80|| prajñānameva tadbrahma satyaprajñānalakṣaṇam | evaṃ brahmaparijñānādeva martyā'mṛto bhavet || 81|| bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ | kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmindṛṣṭe parāvare || 82|| anātmatāṃ parityajya nirvikārau jagatsthitau | ekaniṣṭhatayāntasthaḥ saṃvinmātraparo bhava || 83|| marubhūmau jalaṃ sarvaṃ marubhūmātrameva tat | jagattrayamidaṃ sarvaṃ cinmātraṃ svavicārataḥ || 84|| lakṣyālakṣyamatiṃ tyaktvā yastiṣṭhetkevalātmanā | śiva eva svayaṃ sākṣādayaṃ brahmaviduttamaḥ || 85|| adhiṣṭhānamanaupamyamavāṅmanasagocaram | nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ susūkṣmaṃ ca tadavyayam || 86|| sarvaśaktermaheśasya vilāso hi mano jagat | saṃyamāsaṃyamābhyāṃ ca saṃsāraṃ śāntimanvagāt || 87|| manovyādheścikitsārthamupāyaṃ kathayāmi te | yadyatsvābhimataṃ vastu tattyajanmokṣamaśnute || 88|| svāyattamekāntahitaṃ svepsitatyāgavedanam | yasya duṣkaratāṃ yātaṃ dhiktaṃ puruṣakīṭakam || 89|| svapauruṣekasādhyena svepsitatyāgarūpiṇā | manaḥpraśamamātreṇa vinā nāsti śubhā gatiḥ || 4.90|| asaṃkalpanaśastreṇa chinnaṃ cittamidaṃ yadā | sarvaṃ sarvagataṃ śāntaṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā || 91|| bhava bhāvanayā mukto muktaḥ paramayā dhiyā | dhārayātmānamavyagro grastacittaṃ citaḥ padam || 92|| paraṃ pauruṣamāśritya nītvā cittamacittatām | dhyānato hṛdayākāśe citi ciccakradhārayā || 93|| mano māraya niḥśaṅkaṃ tvāṃ prabadhnanti nārayaḥ || 94|| ayaṃ so'hamidaṃ tanma etāvanmātrakaṃ manaḥ | tadabhāvanamātreṇa dātreṇeva vilīyate || 95|| chinnābhramaṇḍalaṃ vyomni yathā śaradi dhūyate | vātena kalpakenaiva tathāntardhūyate manaḥ || 96|| kalpāntapavanā vāntu yāntu caikatvamarṇavāḥ | tapantu dvādaśādityā nāsti nirmanasaḥ kṣatiḥ || 97|| asaṃkalpanamātraikasādhye sakalasiddhide | asaṃkalpātisāmrājye tiṣṭhavaṣṭabdhatatpadaḥ || 98|| na hi cañcalatāhīnaṃ manaḥ kvacana dṛśyate | cañcalatvaṃ manodharmo vahnerdharmo yathoṣṇatā || 99|| eṣā hi cañcalāspandaśaktiścittatvasaṃsthitā | tāṃ viddhi mānasīṃ śaktiṃ jagadāḍaṃbarātmikām || 4.100|| yattu cañcalatāhīnaṃ tanmano'mṛtamucyate | tadeva ca tapaḥ śāstrasiddhānte mokṣa ucyate || 101|| tasya cañcalatā yaiṣā tvavidyā vāsanātmikā | vāsanāparanāmnīṃ tāṃ vicāreṇa vināśaya || 102|| pauruṣeṇa prayatnena yasminnaiva pade manaḥ | yojyate tatpadaṃ prāpya nirvikalpo bhavānagha || 103|| ataḥ pauruṣamāśritya cittamākramya cetasā | viśokaṃ padamālambya nirātaṅkaḥ sthiro bhava || 104|| mana eva samarthaṃ hi manaso dṛḍhanigrahe | arājakaḥ samarthaḥ syādrājño nigrahakarmaṇi || 105|| tṛṣṇāgrāhagṛhītānāṃ saṃsārārṇavapātinām | āvartairūhyamānānāṃ dūraṃ svamana eva nauḥ || 106|| manasaiva manaśchittvā pāśaṃ paramabandhanam | bhavāduttārayātmānaṃ nāsāvanyena tāryate || 107|| yā yodeti manonāmnī vāsanā vāsitāntarā | tāṃ tāṃ pariharetprājñastato'vidyākṣayo bhavet || 108|| bhogaikavāsanāṃ tyaktvā tyaja tvaṃ bhedavāsanām | bhāvābhāvau tatastyaktyā nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhava || 109|| eṣa eva manonāśastvavidyānāśa eva ca | yattatsaṃvedyate kiṃcittatrāsthāparivarjanam || 4.110|| anāsthaiva hi nirvāṇaṃ duḥkhamāsthāparigrahaḥ || 111|| avidyā vidyamānaiva naṣṭaprajñeṣu dṛśyate | nāmnaivāṅgīkṛtākārā samyakprajñasya sā kutaḥ || 112|| tāvatsaṃsārabhṛguṣu svātmanā saha dehinam | āndolayati nīrandhraṃ duḥkhakaṇṭakaśāliṣu || 113|| avidyā yāvadasyāstu notpannā kṣayakāriṇī | svayamātmāvalokecchāa mohasaṃkṣayakāriṇī || 114|| asyāḥ paraṃ prapaśyantāḥ svātmanāśaḥ prajāyate | dṛṣṭe sarvagate bodhe svayaṃ hyeṣā vilīyate || 115|| icchāmātramavidyeyaṃ tannāśo mokṣa ucyate | sa cāsaṃkalpamātreṇa siddho bhavati vai mune || 116|| manāgapi manovyomni vāsanārajanī kṣaye | kālikā tanutāmeti cidādityāprakāśanāt || 117|| caitānyupātarahitaṃ sāmānyena ca sarvagam | yaccittattvamanākhyeyaṃ sa ātmā parameśvaraḥ || 118|| sarvaṃ ca khalvidaṃ brahma nityacidghanamakṣatam | kalpanānyā manonāmnī vidyate na hi kācana || 119|| na jāyate na mriyatte kiṃcidatra jagattraye | na ca bhāvavikārāṇāṃ sattā kvacana vidyate || 4.120|| kevalaṃ kevalābhāsaṃ sarvasāmānyamakṣatam | caityānupātarahitaṃ cinmātramiha vidyate || 121|| tasminnitye tate śuddhe cinmātre nirupadrave | śānte śamasamābhoge nirvikāre cidātmani || 122|| yaiṣā svabhāvābhimataṃ svayaṃ saṃkalpya dhāvati | ciccaityaṃ svayamamlānaṃ mānanānmana ucyate | ataḥ saṃkalpasiddheyaṃ saṃkalpenaiva naśyati || 123|| nāhaṃ brahmeti saṃkalpātsudṛḍhādbadhyate manaḥ | sarvaṃ brahmeti saṃkalpātsudṛḍhānmucyate manaḥ || 124|| kṛśo'haṃ duḥkhabaddho'haṃ hastapādādimānaham | iti bhāvānurūpeṇa vyavahāreṇa badhyate || 125|| nāhaṃ duḥkhī na me deho bandhaḥ ko'syātmani sthitaḥ | iti bhāvānurūpeṇa vyavahāreṇa mucyate || 126|| nāhaṃ māṃsaṃ na cāsthīni dehādanyaḥ paro'smyaham | iti niścitavānantaḥ kṣīṇāvidyo vimucyate || 127|| kalpiteyamavidyeyamanātmanyātmabhāvanāt | paraṃ pauruṣamāśritya yatnātparamayā dhiyā | bhogecchāṃ dūratastyaktvā nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhava || 128|| mama putro mama dhanamahaṃ so'yamidaṃ mama | itīyamindrajālena vāsanaiva vivalgati || 129|| mā bhavājño bhava jñastvaṃ jahi saṃsārabhāvanām | anātmanyātmabhāvena kimajña iva rodiṣi || 4.130|| kastavāyaṃ jaḍo mūko deho māṃsamayo'śuciḥ | yadarthaṃ sukhaduḥkhābhyāmavaśaḥ paribhūyase || 131|| aho nu citraṃ yatsatyaṃ brahma tadvismṛtaṃ nṛṇām | tiṣṭhatastava kāryeṣu māstu rāgānurañjanā || 132|| aho nu citraṃ padmotthairbaddhāstantubhiradrayaḥ | avidyamāna yā vidyā tayā viśvaṃ khilīkṛtam || 4.133|| idaṃ tadvajratāṃ yātaṃ tṛṇamātraṃ jagattrayam || ityupaniṣat || iti caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4|| ṛbhuḥ || athāparaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāta yathāyatham | ajñānabhūḥ saptapadā jñabhūḥ saptapadaiva hi || 5.1|| padāntarāṇyasaṃkhyāni prabhavantyanyathaitayoḥ | svarūpāvasthitirmuktistadbhraṃśo'haṃtvavedanam || 2|| śuddhasanmātrasaṃvitteḥ svarūpānna calanti ye | rāgadveṣādayo bhāvāsteṣāṃ nājñatvasaṃbhavaḥ || 3|| yaḥ svarūpaparibhraṃśaścetvārthe citi majjanam | etasmādaparo moho na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 4|| arthādarthāntaraṃ citte yāti madhye tu yā sthitiḥ | sā dhvastamananākārā svarūpasthitirucyate || 5|| saṃśāntasarvasaṃkalpā yā śilāvadavasthitiḥ | jāgrannidrāvinirmuktā sā svarūpasthitiḥ parā || 6|| ahantāṃśe kṣate śānte bhedaniṣpandacittatā | ajaḍā yā pracalati tatsvarūpamitīritam || 7|| bījaṃ jāgrattathā jāgranmahājāgrattathaiva ca | jāgratsvapnastathā svapnaḥ svapnajāgratsuṣuptikam || 8|| iti saptavidho mohaḥ punareṣa parasparam | śliṣṭo bhavatyanekāgryaṃ śruṇu lakṣaṇamasya tu || 9|| prathamaṃ cetanaṃ yatsyādanākhyaṃ nirmalaṃ citaḥ | bhaviṣyaccittajīvādināmaśabdārthabhājanam || 5.10|| bījarūpasthitaṃ jāgradbījajāgrattaducyate | eṣā jñapternavāvasthā tvajāgratsaṃsthitiṃ śruṇu || 11|| navaprasūtasya parādayaṃ cāhamidaṃ mama | iti yaḥ pratyayaḥ svasthastajjāgratprāgabhāvanāt || 12|| ayaṃ so'hamidaṃ tanma iti janmāntaroditaḥ | pīvaraḥ pratyayaḥ prokto mahājāgraditi sphuṭam || 13|| arūḍhamathavā rūḍhaṃ sarvathā tanmayātmakam | yajjāgrato manorājyaṃ yajjāgratsvapna ucyate || 14|| dvicandraśuktikārūpyamṛgatṛṣṇādibhedataḥ | abhyāsaṃ prāpya jāgrattatsvapno nānāvidho bhavet || 15|| alpakālaṃ mayā dṛṣṭametannodeti yatra hi | parāmarṣaḥ prabuddhasya sa svapna iti kathyate || 16|| ciraṃ saṃdarśanābhāvādapraphullaṃ bṛhadvacaḥ | cirakālānuvṛttistu svapno jāgradivoditaḥ || 17|| svapnajāgraditi proktaṃ jāgratyapi parisphurat | ṣaḍavasthā parityāgo jaḍā jīvasya yā sthitiḥ || 18|| bhaviṣyadduḥkhabodhāḍhyā sauṣuptiḥ socyate gatiḥ | jagattasyāmavasthāyāmantastamasi līyate || 19|| saptāvasthā imāḥ proktā mayā jñānasya vai dvija | ekaikā śatasaṃkhyātra nānāvibhavarūpiṇī || 5.20|| imāṃ saptapadāṃ jñānabhūmimākarṇayānagha | nānayā jñātayā bhūyo mohapaṅke nimajjati || 21|| vadanti bahubhedena vādino yogabhūmikāḥ | mama tvabhimatā nūnamimā eva śubhapradāḥ || 22|| avabodhaṃ vidurjñānaṃ tadidaṃ sāptabhūmikam | muktistu jñeyamityuktā bhūmikāsaptakātparam || 23|| jñānabhūmiḥ śubhecchākhyā prathamā samudāhṛtā | vicāraṇā dvitīyā tu tṛtīyā tanumānasī || 24|| sattvāpattiścaturthī syāttato'saṃsaktināmikā | padārthabhāvanā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī turyagā smṛtā || 25|| āsāmantasthitā muktiryasyāṃ bhūyo na śocati | etāsāṃ bhūmikānāṃ tvamidaṃ nirvacanaṃ śruṇu || 26|| sthitaḥ kiṃ mūḍha evāsmi prekṣe'haṃ śāstrasajjanaiḥ | vairāgyapūrvamiccheti śubhecchetyucyate budhaiḥ || 27|| śāstrasajjanasaṃparkavairāgyābhyāsapūrvakam | sadācārapravṛttiryā procyate sā vicāraṇā || 28|| vicāraṇāśubhecchābhyāmindriyārtheṣu raktatā | yatra sā tanutāmeti procyate tanumānasī || 29|| bhūmikātritayābhyāsāccitte tu viratervaśāt | sattvātmani sthite śuddhe sattvāpattirudāhṛtā || 5.30|| daśācatuṣṭayābhyāsādasaṃsargakalā tu yā | rūḍhasattvacamatkārā proktā saṃsaktināmikā || 31|| bhūmikāpañcakābhyāsātsvātmārāmatayā dṛḍham | ābhyantarāṇāṃ bāhyānāṃ padārthānāmabhāvanāt || 32|| paraprayuktena ciraṃ prayatnenāvabodhanam | padārthabhāvanā nāma ṣaṣṭhī bhavati bhūmikā || 33|| bhūmiṣaṭkacirābhyāsādbhedasyānupalambanāt | yatsvabhāvaikaniṣṭhatvaṃ sā jñeyā turyagā gatiḥ || 34|| eṣā hi jīvanmukteṣu turyāvastheti vidyate | videhamuktiviṣayaṃ turyātītamataḥ param || 35|| ye nidāgha mahābhāgāḥ sāptamīṃ bhūmimāśritāḥ | ātmārāmā mahātmānaste mahatpadamāgatāḥ || 36|| jīvanmuktā na majjanti sukhaduḥkharasasthite | prakṛtenātha kāryeṇa kiṃcitkurvanti vā na vā || 37|| pārśvasthabodhitāḥ santaḥ pūrvācarakramāgatam | ācāramācaratyeva suptabuddhavadutthitāḥ || 38|| bhūmikāsaptakaṃ caitaddhīmatāmeva gocaram | prāpya jñānadaśāmetāṃ paśumlecchādayo'pi ye || 39|| sadehā vāpyadehā vā te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ | jñaptirhi granthivicchedastasminsati vimuktatā || 5.40|| mṛgatṛṣṇāmbubuddhyyādiśāntimātrātmakastvasau | ye tu mohārṇavāttīrṇāstaiḥ prāptaṃ paramaṃ padam || 41|| te sthitā bhūmikāsvāsu svātmalābhaparāyaṇāḥ | manaḥpraśamanopāyo yoga ityabhidhīyate || 42|| saptabhūmiḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kathitāstāśca bhūmikāḥ | etāsāṃ bhūmikānāṃ tu gamaṃ brahmābhidhaṃ padam || 43|| tvattāhantātmatā yatra paratā nāsti kācana | na kvacidbhāvakalanā na bhāvābhāva gocarā || 44|| sarvaṃ śāntaṃ nirālambaṃ vyomasthaṃ śāśvataṃ śivam | anāmayamanābhāsamanāmakamakāraṇam || 45|| na sannasanna madhyāntaṃ na sarvaṃ sarvameva ca | manovacobhiragrāhyaṃ pūrṇātpūrṇaṃ sukhātsukham || 46|| asaṃvedanamāśāntamātmavedanamātatam | sattā sarvapadārthānāṃ nānyā saṃvedanādṛte || 47|| saṃbandhe draṣṭṛdṛśyānāṃ madhye dṛṣṭirhi yadvapuḥ | draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyādivarjitaṃ tadidaṃ padam || 48|| deśāddeśaṃ gate citte madhye yaccetaso vaouḥ | ajāḍyasaṃvinmananaṃ tanmayo bhava sarvadā || 49|| ajāgratsvapnanidrasya yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam | acetanaṃ cājaḍaṃ ca tanmayo bhava sarvadā || 5.50|| jaḍatāṃ varjayitvaikāṃ śilāyā hṛdayaṃ hi tat | amanaskasvarūpaṃ yattanmayo bhava sarvadā | cittaṃ dūre parityajya yo'si so'si sthiro bhava || 51|| pūrvaṃ manaḥ samuditaṃ paramātmatattvā ttenātataṃ jagadidaṃ savikalpajālam | śūnyena śūnyamapi vipra yathāmbareṇa nīlatvamullasati cārutarābhidhānam || 52|| saṃkalpasaṃkṣayadgalite tu citte saṃsāramohamihikā galitā bhavanti | svacchaṃ vibhāti śaradīva khamāgatāyāṃ cinmātramekamajamādyamanantamantaḥ || 53|| akartṛkamaraṅgaṃ ca gagane citramutthitam | adraṣṭṛkaṃ svānubhavamanidrasvapnadarśanam || 54|| sākṣibhūte same svacche nirvikalpe cidātmani | niricchaṃ pratibimbanti jaganti mukure yathā || 55|| ekaṃ brahma cidākāśaṃ sarvātmakamakhaṇḍitam | iti bhāvaya yatnena cetaścāñcalyaśāntaye || 56|| rekhoparekhāvalitā yathaikā pīvarī śilā | tathā trailokyavalitaṃ brahmaikamiha dṛśyatām || 57|| dvitīyakāraṇābhāvādanutpannamidaṃ jagat | jñātaṃ jñātavyamadhunā dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyamadbhutam || 58|| viśrānto'smi ciraṃ śrāntaścinmātrānnāsti kiṃcana | paśya viśrāntasandehaṃ vigatāśeṣakautukam || 59|| nirastakalpanājālamacittatvaṃ paraṃ padam | ta eva bhūmatāṃ prāptāḥ saṃśāntāśeṣakilbiṣāḥ || 5.60|| mahādhiyaḥ śāntadhiyo ye yātā vimanaskatām | jantoḥ kṛtavicārasya vigaladvṛtticetasaḥ || 61|| mananaṃ tyajato nityaṃ kiṃcitpariṇataṃ manaḥ | dṛśyaṃ santyajato heyamupādeyamupeyuṣaḥ || 62|| draṣṭāraṃ paśyato nityamadraṣṭāramapaśyataḥ | vijñātavye pare tattve jāgarūkasya jīvataḥ || 63|| suptasya dhanasaṃmohamaye saṃsāravartmani | atyantapakvavairāgyādaraseṣu raseṣvapi || 64|| saṃsāravāsanājāle khagajāla ivādhunā | troṭite hṛdayagranthau ślathe vairāgyaraṃhasā || 65|| kātakaṃ phalamāsādya yathā vāri prasīdati | tathā vijñānavaśataḥ svabhāvaḥ saṃprasīdati || 66|| nīrāgaṃ nirupāsaṅgaṃ nirdvandvaṃ nirupāśrayam | viniryāti mano mohādvihaṅgaḥ pañjarādiva || 67|| śāntasandehadaurātmyaṃ gatakautukavibhramam | paripūrṇāntaraṃ cetaḥ pūrṇenduriva rājate || 68|| nāhaṃ na cānyadastīha brahmaivāsmi nirāmayam | itthaṃ sadastormadhyādyaḥ paśyati sa paśyati || 69|| ayatnopateṣvakṣidṛgdṛśyeṣu yathā manaḥ | nīrāgameva patati tadvatkāryeṣu dhīradhīḥ || 5.70|| parijñāyopabhukto hi bhogo bhavati tuṣṭaye | vijñāya sevitaścoro maitrīmeti na coratām || 71|| aśaṅkitāpi saṃprāptā grāmayātrā yathādhvagaiḥ | prekṣyate tadvadeva jñairbhogaśrīravalokyate || 72|| manaso nigṛhītasya līlābhogo'lpako'pi yaḥ | tamevālabdhavistāraṃ kliṣṭatvādbahu manyate || 73|| baddhamukto mahīpālo grāsamātreṇa tuṣyati | parairabaddho nākrānto na rāṣṭraṃ bahu manyate || 74|| hastaṃ hatena saṃpīḍya dantairdantānvicūrṇya ca | aṅgānyaṅgairivākramya jayedādau svakaṃ manaḥ || 75|| manaso vijayānnānyā gatirasti bhavārṇave | mahānarakasāmrājye mattaduṣkṛtavāraṇāḥ || 76|| āśāśaraśalākāḍhyā durjayā hīndriyārayaḥ | prakṣīṇacittadarpasya nigṛhītendriyadviṣaḥ || 77|| padminya iva hemante kṣīyante bhogavāsanāḥ | tāvanniśīva vetālā vasanti hṛdi vāsanāḥ | ekatattvadṛḍhābhyāsādyāvanna vijitaṃ manaḥ || 78|| bhṛtyo'bhimatakartṛtvānmantrī sarvārthakāraṇāt | sāmantaścendriyākrāntermano manye vivekinaḥ || 79|| lālanātsnigdhalalanā pālānātpālakaḥ pitā | suhṛduttamavinyāsānmano manye manīṣiṇaḥ || 5.80|| svālokataḥ śāstradṛśā svabuddhyā svānubhāvataḥ | prayacchati parāṃ siddhiṃ tyaktvātmānaṃ manaḥpitā || 81|| suhṛṣṭaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ svacchaḥ sukrāntaḥ suprabodhitaḥ | svaguṇenorjito bhāti hṛdi hṛdyo manomaṇiḥ || 82|| enaṃ manomaṇiṃ brahmanbahupaṅkakalaṅkitam | vivekavāriṇā siddhyai prakṣālyālokavānbhava || 83|| vivekaṃ paramāśritya buddhyā satyamavekṣya ca | indriyārīnalaṃ chittvā tīrṇo bhava bhavārṇavāt || 84|| āsthāmātramanantānāṃ duḥkhānāmākaraṃ viduḥ | anāsthāmātramabhitaḥ sukhānāmālayaṃ viduḥ || 85|| vāsanātantubaddho'yaṃ loko viparivartate | sā prasiddhātiduḥkhāya sukhāyocchedamāgatā || 86|| dhīro'pyatibahujño'pi kulajo'pi mahānapi | tṛṣṇayā badhyate jantuḥ siṃhaḥ śṛṅkhalayā yathā || 87|| paramaṃ pauruṣaṃ yatnamāsthādāya sṛdyamam | yathāśāstramanudvegamācaranko na siddhibhāk || 88|| ahaṃ sarvamidaṃ viśvaṃ paramātmāhamacyutaḥ | nānyadastīti saṃvittyā paramā sā hyahaṅkṛtiḥ || 89|| sarvasmādvyatirikto'haṃ vālāgrādapyahaṃ tanuḥ | iti yā saṃvido brahmandvitīyāhaṅkṛtiḥ śubhā || 5.90|| mokṣāyaiṣā na bandhāya jīvanmuktasya vidyate || 91|| pāṇipādādimātro'yamahamityeṣa niścayaḥ | ahaṃkārastṛtīyo'sau laikikastuccha eva saḥ || 92|| jīva eva durātmāsau kandaḥ saṃsāradustaroḥ | anenābhihato janturadho'dhaḥ paridhāvati || 93|| anayā durahaṃkṛtyā bhāvātsaṃtyaktayā ciram | śiṣṭāhaṃkāravāñjantuḥ śamavānyāti muktatām || 94|| prathamau dvāvahaṃkārāvaṅgīkṛtya tvalaukikau | tṛtīyāhaṃkṛtistyājyā laukikī duḥkhadāyinī || 95|| atha te api saṃtyajya sarvāhaṃkṛtivarjitaḥ | sa tiṣṭhati tathātyuccaiḥ paramevādhirohati || 96|| bhogecchāmātrako bandhastattyāgo mokṣa ucyate | manaso'bhyudayo nāśo manonāśo mahodayaḥ || 97|| jñamano nāśamabhyeti mano'jñasya hi śṛṅkhalā | nānandaṃ na nirānandaṃ na calaṃ nācalaṃ sthiram | na sannāsanna caiteṣāṃ madhyaṃ jñānimano viduḥ || 98|| yathā saukṣmyāccidābhāsya ākāśo nopalakṣyate | tathā niraṃśaścidbhāvaḥ sarvago'pi na lakṣyate || 99|| sarvasaṃkalparahitā sarvasaṃjñāvivarjitā | saiṣā cidavināśātmā svātmetyādikṛtābhidhā || 5.100|| ākāśaśatabhāgāṇchā jñeṣu niṣkalarūpiṇī | sakalāmalasaṃsārasvarūpaikātmadarśinī || 101|| nāstameti na codeti nottiṣṭhati na tiṣṭhati | na ca yāti na cāyāti na ca neha na ceha cit || 102|| saiṣā ciyamalākārā nirvikalpā nirāspadā || 103|| ādau śamadamaprāyairguṇaiḥ śiṣyaṃ viśodhayet | paścātsarvamidaṃ brahma śuddhastvamiti bodhayet || 104|| ajñasyārdhaprabuddhasya sarvaṃ brahmeti yo vadet | mahānarakajāleṣu sa tena viniyojitaḥ || 105|| prabuddhabuddheḥ prakṣīṇabhogecchasya nirāśiṣaḥ | nāstyavidyāmalamiti prājñastūpadiśedguruḥ || 106|| sati dīpa ivālokaḥ satyarka iva vāsaraḥ | sati puṣpa ivāmodaściti satyaṃ jagattathā || 107|| pratibhāsata evedaṃ na jagatparamārthataḥ | jñānadṛṣṭau prasannāyāṃ prabodhavitatodaye || 108|| yathāvajjñāsyasi svastho madvāgvṛṣṭibalābalam | avidyayaivottamayā svārthanāśodyamārthayā || 109|| vidyā saṃprāpyate brahmansarvadoṣāpahāriṇī | śāmyati hyastramastreṇa malena kṣālyate malam || 5.110|| śamaṃ viṣaṃ viṣeṇaiti ripuṇā hanyate ripuḥ | īdṛśī bhūtamāyeyaṃ yā svanāśena harṣadā || 111|| na lakṣyate svabhāvo'syā vīkṣyamāṇaiva naśyati | nāstyeṣā paramārthenetyevaṃ bhāvanayeddhayā || 112|| sarvaṃ brahmeti yasyāntarbhāvanā sā hi muktidā | bhedadṛṣṭiravidyeyaṃ sarvathā tāṃ visarjayet || 113|| mune nāsādyate taddhi padamakṣayamucyate | kuto jāteyamiti te dvija māstu vicāraṇā || 114|| imāṃ kathamahaṃ hanmītyeṣā te'stu vicāraṇā | astaṃ gatāyāṃ kṣīṇāyāmasyāṃ jñāsyasi tatpadam || 115|| yata eṣā yathā caiṣā yathā naṣṭetyakhaṇḍitam | tadasyā rogaśālāyā yatnaṃ kuru cikitsane || 116|| yathaiṣā janmaduḥkheṣu na bhūyastvāṃ niyokṣyati | svātmani svaparispandaiḥ sphuratyacchaiścidarṇavaḥ || 117|| ekātmakamakhaṇḍaṃ tadityantarbhāvyatāṃ dṛḍham | kiṃcitkṣubhitarūpā sā cicchaktiścinmayārṇave|| 118|| tanmayaiva sphuratyacchā tatraivormirivārṇave | ātmanyevātmanā vyomni yathā sarasi mārutaḥ || 119|| tathaivātmātmaśaktyaiva svātmanyevaiti lolatām | kṣaṇaṃ sphurati sā devī sarvaśaktitayā tathā || 5.120|| deśakālakriyāśaktirna yasyāḥ saṃprakarṣaṇe | svasvabhāvaṃ viditvoccairapyanantapade sthitā || 121|| rūpaṃ parimitenāsau bhāvayatyavibhāvitā | yadaivaṃ bhāvitaṃ rūpaṃ tayā paramakāntayā || 122|| tadaivaināmanugatā nāmasaṃkhyādikā dṛśaḥ | vikalpakalitākāraṃ deśakālakriyāspadam || 123|| cito rūpamidaṃ brahmankṣetrajña iti kathyate | vāsanāḥ kalpayanso'pi yātyahaṃkāratāṃ punaḥ || 124|| ahaṅkāro vinirṇetā kalaṅkī buddhirucyate | buddhiḥ saṃkalpitākārā prayāti mananāspadam || 125|| mano ghanavikalpaṃ tu gacchatīndriyatāṃ śanaiḥ | pāṇipādamayaṃ dehamindriyāṇi vidurbudhāḥ || 126|| evaṃ jīvo hi saṃkalpavāsanārajjuveṣṭitaḥ | duḥkhajālaparītātmā kramādāyāti nīcatām || 127|| iti śaktimayaṃ ceto ghanāhaṃkāratāṃ gatam | kośakārakrimiriva svecchayā yāti bandhanam || 128|| svayaṃ kalpita tanmātrājālabhyantaravarti ca | parāṃ vivaśatāmeti śṛṅkhalābaddhasiṃhavat || 129|| kvacinmanaḥ kvacidbuddhiḥ kvacijjñānaṃ kvacitkriyā | kvacidetadahaṃkāraḥ kvaciccittamiti smṛtam || 5.130|| kvacitprakṛtirityuktaṃ kvacinmāyeti kalpitam | kvacinmalamiti proktaṃ kvacitkarmeti saṃsmṛtam || 131|| kvacidbandha iti khyātaṃ kvacitpuryaṣṭakaṃ smṛtam | proktaṃ kvacidavidyeti kvacidiccheti saṃmatam || 132|| iamaṃ saṃsāramakhilamāśāpāśavidhāyakam | dadhadantaḥphalairhīnaṃ vaṭadhānā vaṭaṃ yathā || 133|| cintānalaśikhādagdhaṃ kopājagaracarvitam | kāmābdhikallolarataṃ vismṛtātmapitāmaham || 134|| samuddhara mano brahmanmātaṅgamiva kardamāt | evaṃ jīvāśritā bhāvā bhavabhāvanayāhitāḥ || 135|| brahmaṇā kalpitākārā lakṣaśo'pyatha koṭiśaḥ | saṃkhyātītāḥ purā jātā jāyante'dyāpi cābhitaḥ || 136|| utpatsyante'pi caivānye kaṇaughā iva nirjharāt | kecitprathamajanmānaḥ kecijjanmaśatādhikāḥ || 137|| keciccāsaṃkhyajanmānaḥ keciddvitribhavāntarāḥ | kecitkinnaragandharvavidyādharamahoragāḥ || 138|| kecidarkenduvaruṇāstryakṣādhokṣajapadmajāḥ | kecidbrahmaṇabhūpālavaiśyaśūdragaṇāḥ sthitāḥ || 139|| kecittṛṇauṣadhīvṛkṣaphalamūlapataṅgakāḥ | kecitkadambajambīrasālatālatamālakāḥ || 5.140|| kecinmahendramalayasahyamandarameravaḥ | kecitkṣārodadhikṣīraghṛtekṣujalarāśayaḥ || 141|| kecidviśālāḥ kukubhaḥ kecinnadyo mahārayāḥ | vihāyasyuccakaiḥ kecinnipatantyutpatanti ca || 142|| kantukā iva hastena mṛtyunā'virataṃ hatāḥ | bhuktvā janmasahasrāṇi bhūyaḥ saṃsārasaṃkaṭe || 143|| patanti kecidabudhāḥ saṃprāpyāpi vivekatām | dikkālādyanavacchinnamātmatattvaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 144|| līlayaiva yadādatte dikkālakalitaṃ vapuḥ | tadeva jīvaparyāyavāsanāveśataḥ param || 145|| manaḥ saṃpadyate lolaṃ kalanākalanonmukham | kalayantī manaḥśaktirādau bhāvayati kṣaṇāt || 146|| ākāśabhāvanāmacchāṃ śabdabījarasonmukhīm | tatastadghanatāṃ yātaṃ ghanaspandakramānmanaḥ || 147|| bhāvayatyanilaspandaṃ sparśabījarasonmukham | tābhyāmākāśavātābhyāṃ dṛḍhābhyāsavaśāttataḥ || 148|| śabdasparśasvarūpābhyāṃ saṃgharṣājjanyate'nalaḥ | rūpatanmātrasahitaṃ tribhistaiḥ saha saṃmitam || 149|| manastāddṛgguṇagataṃ rasatanmātravedanam | kṣaṇāccetatyapāṃ śaityaṃ jalasaṃvittato bhavet || 5.150|| tatastādṛgguṇagataṃ mano bhāvayati kṣaṇāt | gandhatanmātrametasmādbhūmisaṃvittato bhavet || 151|| athetthaṃbhūtatanmātraveṣṭitaṃ tanutāṃ jahat | vapurvahnikaṇākāraṃ sphuritaṃ vyomni paśyati || 152|| ahaṃkārakalāyuktaṃ buddhibījasamanvitam | tatpuryaṣṭakamityuktaṃ bhūtahṛtpadmaṣaṭpadam || 153|| tasmiṃstu tīvrasaṃvegādbhāvayadbhāsuraṃ vapuḥ | sthūlatāmeti pākena mano bilvaphalaṃ yathā || 154|| mūṣāsthadrutahemābhaṃ sphuritaṃ vimalāmbare | saṃniveśamathādatte tattejaḥ svasvabhāvataḥ || 155|| ūrdhvaṃ śiraḥpiṇḍamayamadhaḥ pādamayaṃ tathā | pārśvayorhastasaṃsthānaṃ madhye codaradharmiṇam || 156|| kālena sphuṭatāmetya bhavatyamalavigraham | buddhisattvabalotsāhavijñānaiśvaryasaṃsthitaḥ || 157|| sa eva bhagavānbrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ | avalokya vapurbrahmā kāntamātmīyamuttamam || 158|| cintāmabhyetya bhagavāṃstrikālāmaladarśanaḥ | etasminparamākāśe cinmātraikātmarūpiṇī || 159|| adṛṣṭapāraparyante prathamaṃ kiṃ bhavediti | iti cintitavānbrahmā sadyo jātāmalātmadṛk || 5.160|| apaśyatsargavṛndāni samatītānyanekaśaḥ | smaratyatho sa sakalānsarvadharmaguṇakramāt || 161|| līlayā kalpayāmāsa citrāḥ saṃkalpataḥ prajāḥ | nānācārasamārambhā gandharvanagaraṃ yathā || 162|| tāsāṃ svargāpavargārthaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye | anantāni vicitrāṇi śāstrāṇi samakalpayat || 163|| virañcirūpānmanasaḥ kalpitatvājjagatsthiteḥ | tāvatsthitiriyaṃ proktā tannāśe nāśamāpnuyāt || 164|| na jāyate na mriyate kvacitkiṃcitkadācana | paramārthena viprendra mithyā sarvaṃ tu dṛśyate || 165|| kośamāśābhujaṅgānāṃ saṃsārāḍaṃbaraṃ tyaja | asadetaditi jñātvā mātṛbhāvaṃ niveśaya || 166|| gandharvanagarasyārthe bhūṣite'bhūṣite tathā | avidyāṃśe sutādau vā kaḥ kramaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 167|| dhanadāreṣu vṛddheṣu duḥkhayuktaṃ na tuṣṭatā | vṛddhāyāṃ mohamāyāyāṃ kaḥ samāśvāsavāniha || 168|| yaireva jāyate rāgo mūrkhasyādhikatāṃ gataiḥ | taireva bhāgaiḥ prājñasya virāga upajāyate || 169|| ato nidāgha tattvajña vyavahāreṣu saṃsṛteḥ | naṣṭaṃ naṣṭamupekṣasva prāptaṃ prāptamupāhara || 5.170|| anāgatānāṃ bhogānāmavāñchanamakṛtrimam | āgatānāṃ ca saṃbhoga iti paṇḍitalakṣaṇam || 171|| śuddhaṃ sadasatormadhyaṃ padaṃ buddhvāvalaṃbya ca | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dṛśyaṃ mā gṛhāṇa vimuñca mā || 172|| yasya cecchā tathānicchā jñasya karmaṇi tiṣṭhataḥ | na tasya lipyate prajñā padmapatramivāmbubhiḥ || 173|| yadi te nendriyārthaśrīḥ spandate hṛdi vai dvija | tadā vijñātavijñeyā samuttīrṇo bhavārṇavāt || 174|| uccaiḥpadāya parayā prajñayā vāsanāgaṇāt | puṣpādgandhamapohyāraṃ cetovṛttiṃ pṛthakkuru || 175|| saṃsārāmbunidhāvasminvāsanāmbupariplute | ye prajñānāvamārūḍhāste tīrṇāḥ paṇḍitāḥ pare || 176|| na tyajanti na vāñchanti vyavahāraṃ jagadgatam | sarvamevānuvartante pārāvāravido janāḥ || 177|| anantasyātmatattvasya sattāsāmānyarūpiṇaḥ | citaścetyonmukhatvaṃ yattatsaṃkalpāṅkuraṃ viduḥ || 178|| leśataḥ prāptasattākaḥ sa eva ghanatāṃ śanaiḥ | yāti cittatvamāpūrya dṛḍhaṃ jāḍyāya meghavat || 179|| bhāvayanti citiścaityaṃ vyatiriktamivātmanaḥ | saṃkalpatāmivāyāti bījamaṅkuratāmiva || 5.180|| saṃkalpanaṃ hi saṃkalpaḥ svayameva prajāyate | vardhate svayamevāśu duḥkhāya na sukhāya yat || 181|| mā saṃkalpaya saṃkalpaṃ mā bhāvaṃ bhāvaya sthitau | saṃkalpanāśane yatto na bhūyo'nanugacchati || 182|| bhāvanābhāvamātreṇa saṃkalpaḥ kṣīyate svayam | saṃkalpenaiva saṃkalpaṃ manasaiva mano mune || 183|| chittvā svātmani tiṣṭha tvaṃ kimetāvati duṣkaram | yathaivedaṃ nabhaḥ śūnyaṃ jagacchūnyaṃ tathaiva hi || 184|| taṇḍulasya yathā carma yathā tāmrasya kālimā | naśyati kriyayā vipra puruṣasya tathā malam || 185|| jīvasya taṇḍulasyeva malaṃ sahajamapyalam | naśyatyeva na sandehastasmādudyogavānbhavet || 5.186|| iti mahopaniṣat || iti pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5|| antarāsthāṃ parityajya bhāvaśrīṃ bhāvanāmayīm | yo'si so'si jagatyasmiṃllīlayā viharānagha || 6.1|| sarvatrāhamakarteti dṛḍhabhāvanayānayā | paramāmṛtanāmnī sā samataivāvaśiṣyate || 2|| khedollāsavilāseṣu svātmakartṛtayaikayā | svasaṃkalpe kṣayaṃ yāte samataivāvaśiṣyate || 3|| samatā sarvabhāveṣu yāsau satyaparā sthitiḥ | tasyāmavasthitaṃ cittaṃ na bhūyo janmabhāgbhavet || 4|| athavā sarvakartṛtvamakartṛtvaṃ ca vai mune | sarvaṃ tyaktvā manaḥ pītvā yo'si so'si sthiro bhava || 5|| śeṣasthiro samādhāno yena tyajasi tattyaja | cinmanaḥkalanākāraṃ prakāśatimirādikam || 6|| vāsanāṃ vāsitāraṃ ca prāṇaspandanapūrvakam | samūlamakhilaṃ tyaktvā vyomasāmyaḥ praśāntadhīḥ || 7|| hṛdayātsaṃparityajya sarvavāsanapaṅktayaḥ | yastiṣṭhati gatavyagraḥ sa muktaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 8|| dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyamakhilaṃ bhrāntaṃ bhrāntyā diśo daśa | yuktyā vai carato jñasya saṃsāro goṣpadākṛtiḥ || 9|| sabāhyābhyantare dehe hyadha ūrdhvaṃ ca dikṣu ca | ita ātmā tato'pyātmā nāstyanātmamayaṃ jagat || 6.10|| na tadasti na yatrāhaṃ na tadasti na tanmayam | kimanyadabhivāñchāmi sarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ tatam || 11|| samastaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma sarvamātmedamātatam | ahamanya idaṃ cānyaditi bhrāntiṃ tyajānagha || 12|| tate brahmaghane nitye saṃbhavanti na kalpitāḥ | na śoko'sti na moho'sti na jarāsti na janma vā || 13|| yadastīha tadevāsti vijvaro bhava sarvadā | yathāprāptānubhavataḥ sarvatrānabhivāñchanāt || 14|| tyāgādānaparityāgī vijvaro bhava sarvadā | yasyedaṃ janma pāścātyaṃ tamāśveva mahāmate || 15|| viśanti vidyā vimalā muktā veṇumivottamam | viraktamanasāṃ samyaksvaprasaṅgādudāhṛtam || 16|| draṣṭurdṛśyasamāyogātpratyayānandaniścayaḥ | yastaṃ svamātmatattvotthaṃ niṣpandaṃ samupāsmahe || 17|| draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyāni tyaktvā vāsanayā saha | darśanapratyayābhāsamātmānaṃ samupāsmahe || 18|| dvayormadhyagataṃ nityamastināstīti pakṣayoḥ | prakāśanaṃ prakāśānāmātmānaṃ samupāsmahe || 19|| santyajya hṛdguheśānaṃ devamanyaṃ prayānti ye | te ratnamabhivāñchanti tyaktahastasthakaustubhāḥ || 6.20|| utthitānutthitānetānindriyārīnpunaḥ punaḥ | hanyādvivekadaṇḍena vajreṇeva harirgirīn || 21|| saṃsārarātriduḥsvapne śūnye dehamaye bhrame | sarvamevāpavitraṃ taddṛṣṭaṃ saṃsṛtivibhramam || 22|| ajñānopahato bālye yauvane vanitāhataḥ | śeṣe kalatracintārtaḥ kiṃ karoti narādhamaḥ || 23|| sato'sattā sthitā mūrdhni ramyāṇāṃ mūrdhnyaramyatā | sukhānāṃ mūrdhniduḥkhāni kimekaṃ saṃśrayāmyaham || 24|| yeṣāṃ nimeṣaṇāmeṣau jagataḥ pralayodayau | tādṛśāḥ puruṣā yānti mādṛśāṃ gaṇanaiva kā || 25|| saṃsāra eva duḥkhānāṃ sīmānta iti kathyate | tanmadhye patite dehe sukhamāsādyate katham || 26|| prabuddho'smi prabuddho'smi duṣṭaścoro'yamātmanaḥ | mano nāma nihanmyenaṃ manasāsmi ciraṃ hṛtaḥ || 27|| mā khedaṃ bhaja heyeṣu nopādeyaparo bhava | heyādeyādṛśau tyaktvā śeṣasthaḥ susthiro bhava || 28|| nirāśatā nirbhayatā nityatā samatā jñatā | nirīhatā niṣkriyatā saumyatā nirvikalpatā || 29|| dhṛrmaitrī manastuṣṭirmṛdutā mṛdubhāṣitā | heyopādeyanirmukte jñe tiṣṭhantyapavāsanam || 6.30|| gṛhītatṛṣṇāśabarīvāsanājālamātatam | saṃsāravāriprasṛtaṃ cintātantubhirātatam || 31|| anayā tīkṣṇayā tāta chindhi buddhiśalākayā | vātyayevāmbudaṃ jālaṃ chittvā tiṣṭha tate pade || 32|| manasaiva manaśchittvā kuṭhāreṇeva pādapam | padaṃ pāvanamāsādya sadya eva sthiro bhava || 33|| tiṣṭhangacchantsvapañjāgrannivasannutpatanpatan | asadevedamityantaṃ niścityāstāṃ parityaja || 34|| dṛśyamāśrayasīdaṃ cettatsaccito'si bandhavān | dṛśyaṃ santyajasīdaṃ cettadā'citto'si mokṣavān || 35|| nāhaṃ nedamiti dhyāyaṃstiṣṭha tvamacalācalaḥ | ātmano jagataścāntardraṣṭṛdṛśyadaśāntare || 36|| darśanākhyaṃ svamātmānaṃ sarvadā bhāvayanbhava | svādyasvādakasaṃtyaktaṃ svādyasvādakamadhyagam || 37|| svadanaṃ kevalaṃ dhyāyanparamātmamayo bhava | avalambya nirālambaṃ madhyemadhye sthiro bhava || 38|| rajjubaddhā vimucyante tṛṣṇābaddhā na kenacit | tasmānnidāgha tṛṣṇā tvaṃ tyaja saṃkalpavarjanāt || 39|| etāmahaṃbhāvamayīpapuṇyāṃ chittvānahaṃbhāva śalākayaiva || svabhāvajāṃ bhavyabhavantabhūmau bhava praśāntākhilabhūtabhītiḥ || 6.40|| ahameṣāṃ padārthānāmete ca mama jīvitam | nāhamebhirvinā kiṃcinna mayaite vinā kila || 41|| ityantarniścayaṃ tyaktvā vicārya manasā saha | nāhaṃ padārthasya na me padārtha iti bhāvite || 42|| antaḥśītalayā buddhyā kurvato līlayā kriyām | yo nūnaṃ vāsanātyāgo dhyeyo brahmanprakīrtitaḥ || 43|| sarvaṃ samatayā buddhyā yaḥ kṛtvā vāsanākṣayam | jahāti nirmamo dehaṃ neyo'sau vāsanākṣayaḥ || 44|| ahaṃkāramayīṃ tyaktvā vāsanāṃ līlayaiva yaḥ | tiṣṭhati dhyeyasaṃtyāgī sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 45|| nirmūlaṃ kalanāṃ tyaktvā vāsanāṃ yaḥ śamaṃ gataḥ | jñeyaṃ tyāgamimaṃ viddhi muktaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇottamam || 46|| dvāvetau brahmatāṃ yātau dvāvetau vigatajvarau | āpatatsu yathākālaṃ sukhaduḥkheṣvanāratau | saṃnyāsiyoginau dāntau viddhi śāntau munīśvara || 47|| īpsitānīpsite na sto yasyāntarvartidṛṣṭiṣu | suṣuptavadyaścarati sa jīvanmukta ucyate || 48|| harṣāmarṣabhayakrodhakāmakārpaṇyadṛṣṭibhiḥ | na hṛṣyati glāyati yaḥ parāmarśavivarjitaḥ || 49|| bāhyārthavāsanodbhūtā tṛṣṇā baddheti kathyate | sarvārthavāsanonmuktā tṛṣṇā mukteti bhaṇyate || 6.50|| idamastu mametyantamicchāṃ prārthanayānvitām | tāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ śṛṅkhalāṃ viddhi duḥkhajanmabhayapradām || 51|| tāmetāṃ sarvabhāveṣu satsvasatsu ca sarvadā | saṃtyajya paramodāraṃ padameti mahāmanāḥ || 52|| bandhāsthāmatha mokṣāsthāṃ sukhaduḥkhadaśāmapi | tyaktvā sadasadāsthāṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhākṣubdhamahābdhivat || 53|| jāyate niścayaḥ sādho puruṣasya caturvidhaḥ || 54|| āpādamastakamahaṃ mātāpitṛvinirmitaḥ | ityeko niścayo brahmanbandhāyāsavilokanāt || 55|| atītaḥ sarvabhāvebhyo vālāgrādapyahaṃ tanuḥ | iti dvitīyo mokṣāya niścayo jāyate satām || 56|| jagajjāla padārthātmā sarva evāhamakṣayaḥ | tṛtīyo niścayaścokto mokṣāyaiva dvijottama || 57|| ahaṃ jagadvā sakalaṃ śūnyaṃ vyoma samaṃ sadā | evameṣa caturtho'pi niścayo mokṣasiddhidaḥ || 58|| eteṣāṃ prathamaḥ proktastṛṣṇayā bandhayogyayā | śuddhatṛṣṇāstrayaḥ svacchā jīvanmuktā vilāsinaḥ || 59|| sarvaṃ cāpyahameveti niścayo yo mahāmate | tamādāya viṣādāya na bhūyo jāyate matiḥ || 6.60|| śūnyaṃ tatprakṛtirmāyā brahmavijñānamityapi | śivaḥ puruṣa īśāno nityamātmeti kathyate || 61|| dvaitādvaitasamudbhūtairjagannirmāṇalīlayā | paramātmamayīśaktiradvaitaiva vijṛmbhate || 62|| sarvātītapadālambī paripūrṇaikacinmayaḥ | nodvegī na ca tuṣṭātmā saṃsāre nāvasīdati || 63|| prāptakarmakaro nityaṃ śatrumitrasamānadṛk | īhitānīhitairmukto na śocati na kāṅkṣati || 64|| sarvasyābhimataṃ vaktā coditaḥ peśaloktimān | āśayajñaśca bhūtānāṃ saṃsāre nāvasīdati || 65|| pūrvāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya dhyeyatyāgavilāsinīm | jīvanmuktatayā svastho loke vihara vijvaraḥ || 66|| antaḥsaṃtyaktasarvāśo vītarāgo vivāsanaḥ | bahiḥsarvasamācāro loke vihara vijvaraḥ || 67|| bahiḥkṛtrimasaṃraṃbho hṛdi saṃrambhavarjitaḥ | kartā bahirakartāntarloke vihara śuddhadhīḥ || 68|| tyaktāhaṃkṛtirāśvastamatirākāśaśobhanaḥ | agṛhītakalaṅkāṅko loke vihara śuddhadhīḥ || 69|| udāraḥ peśalācāraḥ sarvācārānuvṛttimān | antaḥsaṅgaparityāgī bahiḥsaṃbhāravāniva | antarvairāgyamādāya bahirāśonmukhehitaḥ || 6.70|| ayaṃ bandhurayaṃ neti gaṇanā laghucetasām | udāracaritānāṃ tu vasudhaiva kuṭumbakam || 71|| bhāvābhāvavinirmuktaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam | praśāntakalanārabhyaṃ nīrāgaṃ padamāśraya || 72|| eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ svacchā niṣkāmā vigatāmayā | ādāya viharannevaṃ saṃkaṭeṣu na muhyati || 73|| vairāgyeṇātha śāstreṇa mahattvādiguṇairapi | yatsaṃkalpaharārthaṃ tatsvayamevonnayenmanaḥ || 74|| vairāgyātpūrṇatāmeti mano nāśavaśānugam | āśayā raktatāmeti śaradīva saro'malam || 75|| tameva bhuktivirasaṃ vyāpāraughaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | divasedivase kurvanprājña kasmānna lajjate || 76|| ciccaityakalito bandhastanmuktau muktirucyate | cidacaityā kilātmeti sarvasiddhāntasaṃgrahaḥ || 77||
